purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA JMA Standard Receipt Software (Japanese Medical Association open-source medical billing system). It generates and sends a 'Sōkatsu Seikyu Meisaisho Sōfusho' — a detailed claim/receipt transmission cover document for monthly medical insurance billing. It reads temporary claim files, updates receipt DB files, and produces output files including error logs.
